Croft-Leominster Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 80.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Croft-Leominster Inc sold 44,121 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 10,618 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.80M, down from 54,739 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Croft-Leominster Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $933.83B market cap company. The stock increased 1.40% or $2.6312 during the last trading session, reaching $189.9912. About 15.96M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Dearborn Partners Llc decreased its stake in Equifax Inc (EFX) by 6.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dearborn Partners Llc sold 6,758 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.76% with the market. The institutional investor held 94,916 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.19M, down from 101,674 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dearborn Partners Llc who had been investing in Equifax Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $13.81 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.84% or $0.96 during the last trading session, reaching $114.82. About 384,068 shares traded. Equifax Inc. (NYSE:EFX) has declined 14.11% since May 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.66% the S&P500.
